title: Apollo 16 - Nothing So Hidden
description: Apollo 16 documentary (NASA, 1972): the landing and three lunar traverses in the Descartes highlands, the rover Grand Prix, lunar lift-off, a deep-space EVA, and Mission Control problem solving during the pre-landing crisis.
